name: Fore Court Summer Tennis Camp
description_short: A half-day tennis camp (9 AM–12 PM) at Fore Court in Cumberland, RI, for beginner and intermediate juniors ages 5–17. Courts are capped at 4 juniors each. There is also a separate afternoon training camp for advanced, match-ready juniors.
refund_policy_summary: Camps are non-refundable. Full payment is due when you register, and any previous balances must be paid first.
